title: A New Look at Shelter 131/51 in the Natufian Site of Eynan (Ain-Mallaha), Israel
lineage: Original analysis of the early settlement's architecture using excavation plans and stratigraphy. Shelter 1 is contextual evidence from the excavations discussed in the paper. Kingery and colleagues separately analysed the material.

passages.locator: The Early Natufian architectural remains, fig. 1
passages.note: The authors describe a lime-plastered bench in Early Natufian Shelter 1 (Layer II). They note differing suggested functions for the shelter and distinguish it from Shelter 131/51.
